programs.title: House of Versace
programs.desc: A chronicle of Donatella Versace's triumph over tragedy by carrying on her brother's powerful legacy after his 1997 slaying.

programs.title: Here Kills the Bride
programs.desc: Carlos' sister finds out that he is getting married in a week to Grace, a girl he just met in a strip club. His sister investigates and gets pulled into a whirlwind of events, putting her own life at risk.

programs.title: Baby Obsession
programs.desc: Anna Gray is pregnant and ready to start a family with her loving husband Jon. But she has no idea that Rachel, the mother of a baby who died from SIDS when Anna babysat her years ago, has been waiting for this day, determined to take back what Anna 'took from me'.

programs.title: Swarmed
programs.desc: The residents of a small town find themselves battling a swarm of hornets which has been sprayed by a super pesticide.

programs.title: Plurality
programs.desc: An action-packed whodunnit cyber thriller. After a bizarre bus accident, Ming Ze wakes from a coma to discover that his mind now shares the consciousness of four fellow passengers – all of them dead; all of them suspects in a serial murder case. To prove his innocence, he evades capture by the police and hunts for the killer’s only surviving victim, all while fighting the internal monsters.

programs.title: The Fountain
programs.desc: As a modern-day scientist, Tommy is struggling with mortality, desperately searching for the medical breakthrough that will save the life of his cancer-stricken wife, Izzi.
